identity: Own complete lossless categorical medoid-VQ adaptation, not original numeric VQ or original lossy ECVQ

references.title: Chou, Lookabaugh, Gray, Entropy-Constrained Vector Quantization, IEEE TASSP 37(1), 1989
references.checked_summary: https://web.stanford.edu/class/ee368b/Handouts/06-Quantization.pdf (Stanford author lecture, pp.4-5); original-paper PDF retrieval timed out
references.use: Rate-aware assignment principle only. Replace numeric squared-error distortion with estimated lossless whole-codeword XOR codelength; representatives are observed medoids. Not a reproduction of original ECVQ.

Direct reuse of the same A1 32-bit arithmetic interval/flush equations and 24-bit integer CDF. Index stream uses existing A1 buffer ABI. Conditional corrections switch serialized CDFs, retaining original symbol order. No A1 library changes.

training: At most 2048 original-order vectors, one deterministic SplitMix64-jittered position per consecutive stratum (fixed seed), to avoid periodic fixed-stride aliasing; farthest Hamming initialization, five assign/medoid-update rounds. All representatives occur in that training set. Rate assignment minimizes smoothed index plus shared-XOR log probability estimates, not a claim of global minimum compressed size. Empty final centers are pruned.
serialization: Version, dimensions, requested/used centers, objective, chosen correction mode and training count; codebook packed at native 4/8-bit width; A1 index CDF and payload; whole-codeword XOR correction with shared CDF or center-position conditional CDFs. Conditional tables only retained when estimated savings cover serialized and base64-expanded table costs. Auto compares actual payload plus exact variable JSON metadata size. All references/parameters/models are serialized, no decoder training or original checkpoint access.
scope: Complete 4/8-bit symbols only, <=1MiB per component. No numeric interpretation or codeword-field splitting. Existing numeric VQ remains an independent plugin. No raw or arithmetic-only fallback; shared fallback remains the complete VQ pipeline.
